articles.title: Conservative leader Poilievre in New York to pitch closer Canada-U.S. ties
articles.summary: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre is in New York City, where his office says he's doing media interviews to "fight for tariff-free trade" with the United States.

articles.title: Family members of Toronto filmmaker describe their pain at hearing for couple found guilty in his death
articles.summary: Family members of a filmmaker found dead in a condo trash compactor in Liberty Village described their grief and anguish at a sentencing hearing Wednesday for the couple found guilty in his death.

articles.title: Mississauga comedy festival with headliner John Mulaney postponed days before event
articles.summary: Organizers of the Great Outdoors Comedy Festival say its cavalcade of laughs set for this weekend in Mississauga, Ont., has been postponed.
